units.source_text: 左大臣按照各人身份，将种种日用物品，以及纪念死者的种种遗物，分别赏赐众侍女。

en.t: The Minister of the Left distributed various daily necessities and keepsakes of the deceased among the ladies-in-waiting according to each person's rank.

units.source_text: 随意为之，并不过分张扬。

en.t: He did so as he saw fit, without making an excessive display of it.
